# Adding a new `sys:` tool to agent smith

## 1. What "agent smith" is

**Agent smith is not an agent definition in a registry — it is the display name of the broker's system voice**, i.e. the `/smith` pane (alias `/crew`, Cmd+O) that hosts the multi-agent relay broker.

Evidence:
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-app/src/cmddefs/work.rs:13-14` — `name: "/smith"`, `desc: "Open agent smith — the multi-agent relay pane (alias: /crew)"`
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/relay.rs:109` — the relay emits its own messages with the sender string `"agent smith"`
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-app/src/chatcard.rs:46` — `matches!(sender, "agent smith" | "crew" | "system" | "broker")`
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-app/src/chatcard.rs:163` — "The broker's Agent-Smith startup splash"
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/sessionlog.rs:65` — `sender == "agent smith"` is a reserved system voice

So: "a new `sys:` tool for agent smith" = a new **built-in tool on the `sys` server** in the broker's tool surface, inherited by every agent smith routes to (and by the swarm).

## 2. How `sys:` tools are defined and registered

There is **no enum/variant**. The surface is a function returning a `Vec<McpTool>` plus a `match` dispatcher. Two servers are crew's own and share the same `@tool server:tool {"json"}` syntax as MCP: `sys` and `lsp`.

### The two authoritative files

**`/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/systools.rs`** (315 lines)
| What | Lines |
|---|---|
| Module doc (the `sys` contract) | 1-6 |
| `CAP` = 64 KB capture cap | 9-10 |
| `enabled()` / `enabled_from()` — `CREW_SYS_TOOLS=0` + mock gate | 12-23 |
| `read_only()` / `read_only_from()` — `CREW_SYS_MODE=readonly` | 25-33 |
| `read_only_block()` — per-tool block message | 35-44 |
| `mode_label()` | 46-53 |
| **`tools() -> Vec<McpTool>`** — the registry; `mk(name, desc, json_schema)` closure at 67-72; the 10 `mk(...)` entries at **73-220** | 55-221 |
| **`call(tool, args) -> Result<String, String>`** — the dispatcher `match` | **223-248** (arms 234-247, "unknown sys tool" message 244-246) |
| `edit()` (batch form) | 250-274 |
| `str_arg()` — required-string helper w/ agent-readable error | 276-281 |
| `write_file()` | 283-286 |
| `list_dir()` + `MAX_ENTRIES` | 288-311 |
| `#[cfg(test)] #[path = "systools_tests.rs"] mod tests;` | 313-315 |

**`/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/tier.rs`** (101 lines) — the reversibility classification
| What | Lines |
|---|---|
| `enum Tier { Read, Reversible, Irreversible }` | 13-22 |
| `Tier::label()` / `needs_approval()` | 24-38 |
| **`sys_tier(tool) -> Option<Tier>`** — the per-tool match; `None` for unlisted | **48-67** |
| `tier_of(server, tool)` | 75-85 |
| `tier_of_tool(&McpTool)` | 87-90 |
| `blocked_by_read_only(tool)` (derived from `sys_tier`, not a hand-kept list) | 92-97 |

### Registration / dispatch chain (no other registry)
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/session.rs:316-326` — `SessionTools::catalog()` calls `systools::tools()` and merges MCP + LSP + integrations
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/session.rs:424-495` — `SessionTools::call()`: approval gate → `sys` dispatch at **471-472** (`systools::call(tool, args)`), `find_tools` special-cased at **460-470**
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/session.rs:208-230` — `Session::tools()` / `tools_with_sys()` (the `CREW_SYS_TOOLS` gate)
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/toolcall.rs:38-66` — `hint_for()` builds the `TOOLS:` prompt block (line 61 hardcodes `sys:grep, sys:glob` in the LOOK FIRST sentence)
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/toolpick.rs:83` — `sys` tools are **never dropped** by the picker
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/toolchoice.rs:87,156` — the model's chooser also always keeps `sys`
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/toolselect.rs:20-42` — `select` / `with_door` (adds `find_tools` back)
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/doctor.rs:43-44,190-193` — `/doctor` shows only "sys tools: full/read-only/disabled", not names
- `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/capabilities.rs:18` — `sys` is deliberately **excluded** from the planner capability lines

### Existing tool inventory (10)
`run`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit`, `find_tools`, `search`, `fetch`, `grep`, `glob`, `list_dir`

### Per-tool implementation modules (all siblings, one responsibility each)
`sysrun.rs`, `sysread.rs`, `sysedit.rs`, `sysgrep.rs` (grep **and** glob), `sysfetch.rs`, `sysfetchtext.rs`, `syssearch.rs`, `syssearchparse.rs`, `syspath.rs` (shared error hint), and `systools.rs` itself. `write_file` and `list_dir` still live inline in `systools.rs`.

Declared in `/home/dev/crew/crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/mod.rs:80-89` (alphabetical, `mod x;` private).

## 3. Conventions

1. **Naming**: file `broker/sys<name>.rs`, one `pub(crate) fn <name>(...) -> Result<String, String>`, sibling `broker/sys<name>_tests.rs` attached with `#[cfg(test)] #[path = "sys<name>_tests.rs"] mod tests;` at the bottom of the module.
2. **Descriptor**: `mk(name, desc, serde_json::json!({...}))` where `desc` is one line, first-person, and carries an inline `{"arg": …}` example. Every schema names `required` (see `systools.rs:63-65` — a missing required arg used to burn a round).
3. **Function signature**: `pub(crate) fn <name>(v: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<String, String>` when it has >2 args (`sysgrep::grep`/`glob`), or typed args when it has ≤2 (`sysrun::run(cmd)`, `sysfetch::fetch(url)`, `syssearch::search(q)`).
4. **Errors are agent-readable sentences**, not `Debug` output, and every not-found path error goes through `syspath::with_hint(action, path, e)` (`syspath.rs:125-130`).
5. **Bounds everywhere**: a named `const` cap per tool (`MAX_HITS`, `MAX_PATHS`, `MAX_ENTRIES`, `FILE_CAP`, `SKIP_DIRS`) plus a "… N more" trailing line.
6. **Tier classification is mandatory** — `tier_tests.rs:9-27` fails the build if `systools::tools()` contains a name absent from `sys_tier`, and `tier_tests.rs:66-77` re-derives read-only blocking from the same table.
7. **Two parallel surfaces must agree**: prose `hint_for` and native JSON-Schema `specs` (both fed from `tools()`, so adding to `tools()` covers both).
8. **File size**: every `.rs` ≤ 200 lines (`CONTRIBUTING.md:44`, `.claude/commands/improve.md:38-40`). `systools.rs` is **already 315 lines** and over the cap — new logic goes in a new `sys*.rs`; only the `mk(...)` entry, the `match` arm, and the "available:" string go into `systools.rs`. (`sysread.rs:1-3` documents this exact split.)
9. **No new dependency** without checking the workspace (`.claude/commands/improve.md:64`); `crates/crew-plugin/Cargo.toml:21-30` shows the annotated-`regex`/`walkdir` pattern if you do.
10. **Wire spelling differs**: `sys:foo` in text, `sys__foo` on the native tool-use path (`toolselect.rs:44-47`).
11. **`find_tools` is not dispatched in `systools::call`** — it is answered in `session.rs:460-470` against the session catalog. Don't add a match arm for it.

## 4. Concrete checklist

### Required
| # | File | Edit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/sys<name>.rs` | **NEW** — implementation, `pub(crate) fn`, caps, `syspath::with_hint` for paths |
| 2 | `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/sys<name>_tests.rs` | **NEW** — happy path, every error path, cap behaviour |
| 3 | `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/mod.rs` | **NEW** `mod sys<name>;` — alphabetical, in the block at **lines 80-89** |
| 4 | `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/systools.rs` | Add `mk("<name>", desc, json!({…}))` in `tools()` (**73-220**) · add `"<name>" => super::sys<name>::<fn>(…)` arm in `call()` (**234-247**) · add `<name>` to the "available: …" string (**244-246**) |
| 5 | `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/tier.rs` | Add the name to `sys_tier` (**48-67**) — `Read`/`Reversible`/`Irreversible` + a WHY comment |
| 6 | `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/tier_tests.rs` | Bump `systools::tools().len()` **10 → 11** and rewrite the sentence (**20-26**) |
| 7 | `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/systools_tests.rs` | Add the name to the `tools_lists_the_sys_surface` array (**16-30**) |
| 8 | `docs/CREW.md` | Tool list **2677-2693**; a prose section after it; `CREW_SYS_MODE` mutating list **2766-2768**; env-var list **2993-2996** |
| 9 | `README.md` | The sys-tools paragraph **562-574** |
| 10 | `CHANGELOG.md` | New `## <version>` at the top; must equal `Cargo.toml`'s `version.workspace` (`appregister.rs:203-211`) |
| 11 | `Cargo.toml` | `version.workspace = "0.24.66"` → bump |

### Conditional
| File | When |
|---|---|
| `crates/crew-plugin/Cargo.toml` | Only if a new dep is needed; annotate with a `# \`sys:<name>\` (broker/sys<name>.rs): …` comment |
| `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/toolcall.rs:56-65` | If the new tool changes the "LOOK FIRST" advice (as `grep`/`glob` did) |
| `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/systools.rs` (other descriptions) | If an existing tool's description should now point at the new one (as `write_file` → `edit`) |
| `docs/docs.html:268` | The hand-maintained website feature list (already stale — omits `edit`, `grep`, `glob`) |
| `crates/crew-app/src/chatcomplete_env_tests.rs:12-35` | Only if you add a `CREW_*` knob — it must be in `docs/CREW.md` or added to `NOT_USER_FACING` |
| `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-02-sys-tools-design.md` | The original spec; historical, usually not edited |
| `docs/superpowers/goals/*.md` | Only if you cite a shipped version (`goaldocs_tests.rs:31-50`) |
| `.superpowers/sdd/ai-loop-2026-09-14.md` | The shipped-table row for this release |

### Tests that need **no** change (derived from `systools::tools().len()`)
`crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/swarmcast_tests.rs:68-72`, `toolpick_tests.rs`, `toolselect_tests.rs`, `session_tests.rs`, `toolcall_tests.rs`.

### Verification gates (`.claude/commands/improve.md:41-46`)
```
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets
cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast
```
Plus the `linecap` ratchet (crew-app only, `crates/crew-app/src/linecap.rs`) and the doc guards (`goaldocs_tests.rs`, `chatcomplete_env_tests.rs`, `cmddefs/parity_tests.rs`, `discover_tests.rs:483-496`).

### Reference commits (exact precedent)
- `40e752e1` — added `sys:edit` (12 files; the minimal recipe)
- `43e106cc` — added `sys:grep` + `sys:glob` (29 files; includes a new dep + a `toolcall.rs` hint change)
</task_result>
</task>

part.text:
Adding a `sys:` tool means adding a tool to the broker's `sys` server (that's what agent smith exposes). Minimum recipe — 5 code files:

**Required**
1. `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/sys<name>.rs` — **new**, the impl (`pub(crate) fn`, named cap const, `syspath::with_hint` for path errors)
2. `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/sys<name>_tests.rs` — **new**, sibling test module
3. `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/mod.rs:80-89` — add `mod sys<name>;` alphabetically
4. `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/systools.rs` — three edits: `mk(...)` in `tools()` (73-220), a match arm in `call()` (234-247), and the `"<name>"` in the "available:" list (244-246)
5. `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/tier.rs:48-67` — add the name to `sys_tier` as Read/Reversible/Irreversible (a test hard-fails if you skip this)
6. `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/tier_tests.rs:20-26` — bump `tools().len()`
7. `crates/crew-plugin/src/broker/systools_tests.rs:16-30` — add to the surface array

**Docs/version**
`docs/CREW.md` (tool list ~2677, `CREW_SYS_MODE` list, env vars), `README.md:562-574`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `Cargo.toml` version bump.

Wiring is automatic — `session.rs:316` and `toolcall.rs:38` both derive from `tools()`, so no registry edits beyond the above. Precedent commit: `40e752e1` (added `sys:edit`, 12 files).
